method: Whole-file manual reading of resource.h; parsed every decimal define and checked names, aliases, capture commands and selected contiguous arithmetic ID groups.
findings: All seven command identifiers requested by language-screenshots.ps1 are defined. This proves source lookup availability, not actual runtime dispatch or screenshot success.
Color button0..7, permission account0..4, permission level0..4 and user-defined cleanup0..9 identifiers are consecutive, matching arithmetic grouping assumptions.
CHKDSK, DEFRAG and SHADOW_COPY base identifiers reserve26 numeric positions before the next command; declarations alone do not prove per-drive handler bounds.
Header declares duplicate scan, sample-large-files and hash-algorithm controls separately. Presence of UI identifiers is not proof of exact duplicate correctness or any test coverage.
Full resource script and non-English catalogs remain outside this increment; declaration consistency does not replace resource compilation.
limits: No Windows resource compilation, executable or command execution tested. Native pHash investigation deferred. Completed repositories remain147/500.
